lead.zh: 把产品、部署、数据、成本与退出条件逐项拆开。目标是形成一份能说明选择原因和未知项的采购记录。
lead.en: Separate product, deployment, data, cost and exit conditions. Aim for a procurement record explaining the choice and unresolved items.

steps: AI 产品 vs AI 模型
生成式 AI 合规义务

zh: 用三个维度对比「调 API」与「自己部署」的总成本
说出更换模型供应商之前必须核实的三件事
看一份供应商评测报告，判断哪些分数可以直接采信、哪些要打问号
en: Compare API usage against self-hosting on three cost dimensions
Name three things to verify before switching model vendors
Read a vendor's evaluation report and say which scores stand up and which need a question mark

answers.zh: 除调用或硬件费，还要算接入、数据处理、维护、监控、复核和迁移。对相同任务量与质量要求计算，避免拿不同范围的报价直接比较。
answers.en: Include integration, data processing, maintenance, monitoring, review and migration beyond API or hardware fees. Compare equal workload and quality requirements.

answers.zh: 核实数据留存与删除方式、服务可用与退役政策、数据和配置的导出迁移条件；把产品版本、条款链接与核验时间写入记录。
answers.en: Verify retention/deletion, availability/retirement policy, and export/migration of data and configuration. Record product version, terms URL and checking date.

answers.zh: 相同基准版本和设置下的结果才适合对照；自选演示和未经披露的设置不能直接外推。要求提供失败样本和与你任务相近的评测说明。
answers.en: Compare results with the same benchmark version and settings. Selected demos and undisclosed setups do not support broad conclusions. Ask for failures and task-relevant evaluation details.
